overview_description.description:
OneChronos is a Smart Market, which is a technical name for marketplaces that use mathematical optimization to match counterparties. Smart markets have a track record of outperforming traditional markets in terms of price improvement, liquidity, trade size, and fairness.

Smart Markets enable Expressive Bidding, a technology that combines the authenticity of voice trading with the benefits of an electronic venue. The unique liquidity generated by Expressive Bidding can benefit all market participants.

OneChronos was established on July 1, 2015 in New York, United States.

product.name: OneChronos US Equities ATS
product.description: A dark alternative trading system for U.S. equities that uses frequent periodic auctions and mathematical optimization to match institutional orders within or at the NBBO.

product.name: Expressive Bidding
product.description: A configurable order-expression capability that lets traders specify price, quantity, substitution, hedging, spread, and multi-security execution constraints for OneChronos auctions.

product.name: Nexus
product.description: A configurable counterparty and matching service accessed through a routing broker for bilateral, one-to-many, and outsourced matching-engine workflows.

product.name: Conditionals
product.description: A conditional-order service for sourcing block liquidity and creating additional execution opportunities on the OneChronos platform.

product.name: European Equities Multilateral Trading Facilities
product.description: Multilateral trading facilities for UK, Swiss, and other European equities operated through OneChronos’s UK and Netherlands subsidiaries.

product.name: OneChronos Spot FX Platform
product.description: A spot foreign-exchange trading platform operated by OneChronos Markets FX LLC for electronic execution of spot FX transactions.
